svg.title: The two carriers of PTP, two places in PacketFlow
svg.desc: Two frames of ptpv2.pcap. Frame 25 is a PTPv2 Sync on UDP 319 to 319 inside IPv4: the flow has a link, an internet and a transport layer, and the application label PTP, given by the port-guarded rule of the dispatch table; the decode is PtpPacket::try_from_udp on the transport payload. Frame 1 is a PTPv2 Pdelay_Req straight over Ethernet, EtherType 0x88F7: the internet layer is named PTP and holds the decoded message in InternetDetails::Ptp; the transport and application layers are None.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
